extracted.intended_audience: Wattpad authors / writers aiming for popular online serial fiction
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating fiction that attracts and retains readers on Wattpad and similar mobile-first, community-driven platforms; emphasizes hooks, cadence, readability, and community engagement over literary subtlety. Useful for serial/romantic/genre fiction creators seeking high readership and interaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality
rubrics_metrics.description: "Tells your own story." Don't copy your favorite writer; distinct voice and concept attract readers in a crowded platform. Variations on existing tropes should add a genuine new wrinkle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize a distinct voice and concept rather than imitation. Tropes are acceptable but must include a genuine new twist that differentiates the work from existing examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-Editing / Readability Mechanics
rubrics_metrics.description: "When there are multiple grammatical errors, spelling mistakes and subject-verb disagreements in each paragraph, your readers may lose concentration." Even on a casual platform, basic mechanics matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure proper grammar, spelling, and sentence-level clarity. Multiple mechanical errors are a reader retention risk; readable prose is a baseline requirement even if style is casual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title and First-line Hook
rubrics_metrics.description: Title Quality: short or catchy; not too long (don't give the whole story away); intriguing enough to make a browser click. First-line/title hook is an important axis for evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft a short, intriguing title and a compelling first line that immediately captures attention without revealing the plot. The title should entice clicks; the first line should lock the reader in.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover Quality
rubrics_metrics.description: "If you have a good book cover, it draws people towards your book... a lot of people do [judge a book by its cover]."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invest in an attractive cover because visual appeal strongly influences click-through and initial impressions on the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tags and Categories (Discoverability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Discoverability is craft-adjacent. Use suitable tags so the right readers find the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply accurate, relevant tags and categories to improve discoverability; tagging is part of the craft of reaching your target audience on Wattpad.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tension and Curiosity
rubrics_metrics.description: "Captivating enough to keep the reader's eyes glued to the screen — build up tension and tickle the reader's curiosity."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustain curiosity through narrative stakes and unanswered questions; pacing and escalating tension are central to keeping readers engaged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter-end Cliffhangers
rubrics_metrics.description: Cliffhangers between chapters are common; chapter-end cliffhangers help retain readers and encourage return visits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: End chapters on unresolved beats or surprises to maximize reads of subsequent chapters. This is especially effective for serial fiction and mobile readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community Engagement / Reader-reaction-driven Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Wattpad is a social platform. Comment on others' work; reply to readers; build relationship. Successful Wattpad fiction is partly a community phenomenon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively engage with the community: respond to comments, interact with other writers/readers, and cultivate relationships that drive shares, votes, and sustained readership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update Cadence and Release Pacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequent, predictable updates retain readers. Long gaps lose audience. Pacing of release matters as much as pacing of plot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a regular, predictable posting schedule to keep readers returning; treat release cadence as part of your storytelling strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong Genre (Romantic or Genre) Hook in Opening Chapters
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong romantic or genre hook in opening chapters is a common pattern of successful Wattpad stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open with clear genre signals and an immediate hook—especially effective in romance and other popular genres—to set reader expectations and attract target audiences quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short Chapters for Mobile Reading
rubrics_metrics.description: Short chapters (mobile reading) — structure chapters to suit mobile consumption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer shorter chapters to fit mobile reading habits; shorter chunks increase the likelihood of completing a chapter and continuing to the next.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct, Unornamented Prose / Accessible Voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct, unornamented prose and an accessible voice (not literary) are prioritized; clarity over literary flourish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use straightforward language and an approachable narrative voice. Avoid dense or literary ornamentation that could slow mobile or casual readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional Intensity over Subtlety
rubrics_metrics.description: Emotional intensity is favored over subtlety; Wattpad values clarity and intensity of feeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize heightened emotional beats and overt sentiment to elicit strong reader reactions; subtlety and ambiguity are less effective for mass engagement on the platform.
